# Beyond Monet

> > Beyond Monet is an immersive art exhibition bringing Claude Monet's Impressionist masterpieces to life through multi-sensory experiences across North American cities.

The site serves as the official hub for Beyond Monet exhibitions, featuring ticketing information for multiple city locations, educational content about Monet's life and artwork, and visitor guides. It also promotes the companion Beyond Van Gogh exhibition in select markets.

## Key Topics

- Beyond Monet immersive experience
- Claude Monet and Impressionism
- Water Lilies series
- Giverny gardens
- Woman with a Parasol
- Camille Doncieux (Monet's muse)
- Immersive art exhibitions
- Beyond Van Gogh companion show
- Monet's cataracts and artistic vision
- Impressionist painting techniques
- Monet auction values and art market
- Japanese Bridge paintings
- Multi-city touring exhibitions
- Interactive art experiences
- 19th-century French art history

## Exhibition Locations

- [Beyond Monet Winnipeg](https://beyondmonet.com/city/winnipeg): Winnipeg exhibition page featuring 400+ Monet works at RBC Convention Centre
- [San Diego - Beyond Monet](https://beyondmonet.com/city/san-diego): San Diego exhibition page for Beyond Monet immersive art experience
- [Charleston - Beyond Monet](https://beyondmonet.com/city/charleston): Charleston exhibition page for Beyond Monet and Beyond Van Gogh shows

## Monet's Life and Art

- [Famous Monet Paintings: An Introductory Guide To Monet's Artwork](https://beyondmonet.com/famous-monet-paintings-an-introductory-guide-to-monets-artwork): Guide to five famous Monet paintings including Impression, Sunrise
- [How Claude Monet's Cataracts Changed Impressionism Forever](https://beyondmonet.com/web-stories/how-claude-monets-cataracts-changed-impressionism-forever): How Monet's cataracts transformed his vision and Impressionist art style
- [Unveiling Camille: Claude Monet's Muse and Hidden Love](https://beyondmonet.com/unveiling-camille-claude-monets-muse-and-hidden-love): Story of Camille Doncieux, Monet's muse and model for Woman with a Parasol
- [Monet and His Muse: The Story of Claude Monet and Camille Doncieux](https://beyondmonet.com/claude-monet-and-camille-doncieux): Biography of Monet's relationship with muse Camille Doncieux
- [Monet's Japanese Bridge](https://beyondmonet.com/web-stories/monets-japanese-bridge): Guide to Monet's Japanese Bridge paintings at Giverny water lily pond

## Art Market and Collections

- [Claude Monet's Paintings Values: Watching Monet's Art for Sale at Auction](https://beyondmonet.com/monet-paintings-value): Monet artwork auction values including Water Lilies and Haystacks series
- [What's Blooming in Monet's Garden: June](https://beyondmonet.com/web-stories/whats-blooming-in-monets-garden-june): June seasonal flower guide for Monet's Giverny garden estate

## Visitor Guides and Events

- [Brush Up on What's to Come at Beyond Monet!](https://beyondmonet.com/brush-up-on-whats-to-come-at-beyond-monet): Spring announcements for Jacksonville, San Diego, Virginia Beach exhibitions
- [Beat the Chill with Beyond Monet: Winter Activities in Portland](https://beyondmonet.com/beat-the-chill-with-beyond-monet): Portland winter activities guide featuring Beyond Monet exhibition
- [5 Reasons to Have Date Night at Beyond Monet](https://beyondmonet.com/web-stories/5-reasons-to-have-date-night-at-beyond-monet): Date night guide for Beyond Monet Jacksonville with RL Lounge drinks

## Optional

- [Final Days in San Diego](https://beyondmonet.com/web-stories/final-days-in-san-diego): Beyond Monet exhibition closing announcement for Del Mar Fairgrounds
- [Jacksonville Opens Friday!](https://beyondmonet.com/web-stories/jacksonville-opens-on-friday-2): Jacksonville opening announcement at NOCO Center downtown venue
- [5 New Year's Resolutions You Can Complete at Beyond Monet](https://beyondmonet.com/web-stories/5-new-years-resolutions-you-can-complete-at-beyond-monet): New Year's resolutions visitor guide for Beyond Monet immersive experience
